rappel_detail.anchor: existing natural anchor on the ramp (questionable quality)
rappel_detail.station: Where the access ramp necks down to a slabby downclimb, above the snowfield.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, optional: it keeps the descent at 4th class. Without it, the slab is unprotected low-5th downclimbing to the snow.
hazards: The existing natural anchors here are reported to be of questionable quality; back them up or build your own.

set.rappels: One optional rappel on the Corkscrew descent, from the end of the access ramp down the slabs to the snowfield; otherwise unprotected low-5th downclimbing
